cliFlags.reason: pi-rust ships ACP mode (pi --mode acp, ported from pi-acp); an ACP client relaunches pi with this flag for Terminal Auth. Upstream pi has no ACP mode.

settings.reason: pi-rust extension: global-only provider exclusions across model selectors and registry refreshes; credentials are preserved. The TUI /settings menu edits it and applies the change immediately.
pi-rust additionally ships ghostty, darcula-islands, nord, and catppuccin harness themes. The setting remains upstream-compatible.

Upstream registers /mcp from its built-in mcp extension (extensions/mcp). pi-rust implements MCP natively and lists /mcp as a built-in command.
Upstream registers /llama from its built-in llama extension (extensions/llama). pi-rust implements llama.cpp support natively and lists /llama as a built-in command.
pi-rust extension: /extensions browser for installed extensions and the marketplace

extensionApi.reason: pi-rust extension: `ctx.ui.writeTerminal(data, { tmuxPassthrough })` writes raw escape sequences between frames, for the iTerm2 integration as an extension. Upstream has no such call.
pi-rust extension: footer data `getSessionStats()` gives the token, cost, and context numbers of the built-in footer, for the status line as an extension.
pi-rust extension: footer data `getRunState()` gives the program state (`idle`, `working`, `blocked`, `done`, `error`) that the iTerm2 tab color uses.
